authorization: 2026-09-15 user adopted the five object-aligned region candidates and requested image counts and dominant MVS supervision support counts. No new training.

frame.v_direction: clockwise perpendicular to u; downward in the approved overview
frame.basis_provenance: Object/road alignment from the source MVS layout; rounded 20 degree campus-axis rotation used in the preceding coordinate inspection. Not a fitted georeferencing transform of the generated image.

inputs.p1_ground_probe_role: 0100_D native MVS points in the old P1 manual R1; source-conditioned diagnostic coordinates, not truth

audit.fused_reference_selection: first original PLY row per 1m XYZ voxel from deterministic stride-16 sample; input support diagnostic only
audit.candidate_rule: At least max(10,1 percent) sampled region MVS points project in frame OR at least 100 native MVS pixels backproject inside the region. Pose projection is not visibility.
audit.split_rule: Within each region's candidate list sorted by exact name, indices divisible by 8 are evaluation candidates; remaining are training candidates. This is a development planning split, not independent test data.
audit.supervision_mass: Per view: exact RGB-ray-resampled positive finite MVS pixels landing in region / all positive finite MVS RGB pixels in that frame. Normalize across equally sampled training views. Assumes finite render depth, equal scalar depth weight, and no extra masks; excludes residuals and geometry Jacobians.
audit.point_support: Same input MVS XYZ point projected into each camera; positive finite native depth and absolute camera-Z residual <= tolerance. Same-estimator agreement, not independent accuracy.
audit.scope: R1-R5 full region plus old P1/P2/P3 core and old P1 correction-ground probe. No optimization, new MVS, rendering, or UAS/reference evaluation.

region_boundary_note: Metric v1 interpretation of the accepted conceptual boxes. Includes full old P1/P2/P3 prism XY, including a slightly wider R2 context. Overlap is retained and reported, not treated as independent area.
